subject: Financial Management and Strategic Management
paper_name: Paper-6: Financial Management and Strategic Management
question_text:
14.  Bio Cure is pioneer in low-cost rapid diagnostic kits and commands strong
brand loyalty in Tier-2 and Tier-3 Indian cities. The company holds a leading
competitive position, thanks to its proprietary technology and wide
distribution network. However, the rapid diagnostic industry is maturing,
with new regulations, consolidation, and slowing growth rates. Many firms
are shifting their focus to Al-powered health platforms, making it harder for
traditional players to innovate without high R&D spend.
Based on the ADL matrix, where is Bio Cure positioned?
(A)  Dominant position in a declining industry
(B)  Strong position in a mature industry
(C)  Tenable position in a growing industry
(D)  Weak position in an ageing industry
(2 Marks)
